text: How did one prisoner save two hundred and seventy-six people in a storm?
The Apostle Paul was being taken under guard to be tried in Rome.
For fourteen days the storm drove the ship. Neither sun nor stars appeared.
Fear not, Paul; God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
The ship was wrecked off the island of Melita. But they all escaped safe to land.
And then a viper fastened on the apostle's hand.
